div.div: Comedy, Drama, Music, Slice of Life

Suddenly thrown together, a group of girls are now debuting as the virtual band, Mugendai Mewtype. They’ve got talent and personality, but no clue how to perform as one. Can they survive, let alone make it to the top in this unforgiving music world?
(Source: Crunchyroll)

Taiyou Asano has settled into his career, having married into the Yozakura spy family. While he still struggles to control the powers granted to him by his wife, Mutsumi Yozakura, Taiyou works hard to complete missions alongside his new siblings. After taking down the organization Tanpopo, Taiyou and the Yozakuras agree to look after six-year-old Ai, one of Tanpopo's test subjects.
However, Taiyou's health soon begins to decline due to the Yozakura blood within his body. He dreams that the first head of the family, Tsubomi Yozakura, gives him a new mission: to kill her. To that end, he will have to learn more about his new family, become a silver-ranked spy, and push himself even more to succeed and continue protecting his family.
(Source: MAL Rewrite)

In Earthclear, everyone is born into a fixed role, and villagers are the weakest of all. Most never rise above Level 5—except Kouji Kagami, who is Level…999?! On a monster hunt, he meets Alice, the Demon King’s daughter, and discovers they share an impossible dream: coexistence between humans and demons. In a world destined for conflict, they charge into battle to defy fate and shatter the rules.
(Source: Crunchyroll)
Koko wa Ore ni Makasete Saki ni Ike to Ittekara 10-nen ga Tattara Densetsu ni Natteita.

Luck, an S-rank mage in the hero’s party, makes a last stand against the Demon King to save his companions. When he finally returns victorious, ten years have passed, and the world praises him as a legendary hero who died in battle. Unable to reclaim his former life, Luck conceals his identity and begins again as “Lock,” an F-rank adventurer forging a future in a world that moved on without him. (Source: Crunchyroll) Note: Koko wa Ore ni Makasete Saki ni Ike to Ittekara 10-nen ga Tattara Densetsu ni Natteita is streaming 3 days in advance of the TV broadcast on Prime Video beginning July 3rd, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 6th, 2026.
